Harness and scenario fully working. Four visual issues identified, documented in style guide, and filed as lcarcat-859/cg7/9jh. Operational and heuristic memories saved for future sessions.
Fixed in chrome.lua: gate top-frame elbow placement on tabline_visible check so an elbow is only placed when a horizontal bar is actually present to connect to

Added --var lcarcat_command_buffer=1 to the command buffer launch; overrode ctrl+a>v in lcarcat.keybindings.conf to use --next-to 'not var:lcarcat_command_buffer', ensuring vsplit always targets the main content pane

Harness teardown now closes all windows, force-kills the tracked kitty pid if it survives close-window, and removes socket + pidfile. Scenarios install trap teardown EXIT INT TERM so cleanup runs on normal exit, error, or Ctrl-C. Verified end-to-end: no kitty/nvim leaks after normal exit or mid-run SIGINT; screenshots preserved. LCARCAT_KEEP_ALIVE=1 opt-in preserves the live kitty for manual inspection.

Root cause was a same-frame race: _lcars_transmit_images was called in precmd immediately before drawing placeholder cells. On first prompt, kitty hadn't processed the transmission before rendering the placeholders, causing the elbow to appear shifted. Fix: move transmission to _lcars_prompt_enable so the image is registered well before the first precmd fires. Both prompts now render at identical offsets. Residual 1 display px at the outer arc edge is the designed transparent corner of the LCARS elbow shape, not a misalignment.

Fixed. Kitty aspect-fits Unicode-placeholder images into cols*cellw x rows*cellh cell box; any dim mismatch produces a horizontal centering inset. Old PNGs were 19x40 pixels; kitty's actual cell.height at font_size 18 is 38 device px. Regenerated at 19x38 (repo assets/), zeroing the inset. For lcarcat-ukn: prompt now probes cell dims via CSI 16t at enable and after SIGWINCH, rebuilds filenames dynamically, and runs gen_swoops.py on-demand for missing sizes. Verified via test/scenarios/prompt_left_edge_pixel.sh (inset = 0 device px) and test/scenarios/prompt_resize_regen.sh (inset = 0 across font-size change from 18 → 24 → 18).
